versions.changelog: Financial AI, LLM/Agent/RAG risk, audit evidence, and ClawHub search optimization.

Initial release of riskforge: an all-in-one code-based risk analysis and test reporting tool.

- Automates risk analysis and creation of functional, performance, and security test strategies/reports.
- Enforces dual-format test reports (Markdown and HTML) with strict, template-based formatting and naming conventions.
- Integrates with git to automatically fill tester info, branch, and commit details in reports.
- Provides a Node.js script for one-click standardized report generation.
- All reports are saved to a unified reports folder with auto-incremented versioning and auto-creation of missing directories.
